body_markdown:
Hamilton, Bermuda, November 3, 2026


The Company has entered into new time charter agreements with their existing charterer for two vessels for a minimum period until 1 October 2027 with a 3-year evergreen structure thereafter. The vessels will commence the new time charters from November 3, 2026. These agreements supersede the existing agreements that were due to expire on December 31, 2026.


The vessels will earn an index linked rate, reflecting significant premiums to the Baltic 5TC index.


For further queries, please contact:
Lars-Christian Svensen, Contracted CEO
Telephone +47 476 38 756


**About Himalaya Shipping Ltd.:**


Himalaya Shipping Ltd. is an independent bulk carrier company, incorporated in Bermuda. Himalaya Shipping has twelve vessels in operation.
